in_hebrew.name: ברלינג
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Barling is derived from the Hebrew word 'bar' which means 'son of' and 'lion' which represents strength and courage. Thus, Barling can be interpreted as 'son of a strong lion'.

in_greek.name: Βαρλίγγος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Barling in Greek is derived from the word 'βαρ' which means 'strong' or 'heavy' and 'λίγγος' which means 'fighter' or 'warrior'. Thus, Barling can be interpreted as 'strong fighter' or 'heavy warrior'.

in_latin.name: Barlingus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Barling in Latin is derived from the word 'bar' which means 'strong' and 'lingus' which means 'tongue' or 'language'. Thus, Barling can be interpreted as 'strong one' or 'powerful speaker'.
